address: Praia das Gaivotas - Alporchinhos, Porches, 8400-450, Portugal
bio: This restaurant, open to non-resident guests, enriches the culinary offering of the Vilalara Grand Hotel Algarve with a purely gastronomic proposal focused on both Atlantic and regional flavours, always from a contemporary perspective yet with deep roots that seek to exalt local produce, featuring fresh shellfish, daily-caught fish and vegetables imbued with the taste of the countryside. You may of course enjoy its tasting menus (Sabores da Estação and A Nossa Escolha) individually, but… best of all with the views from the terrace. Mark it in your diary for a more romantic occasion!
